args.name: Evidence-based assessment of unfamiliar food
args.function: Assess an unfamiliar food source or sample through feasible non-ingestive examination. Distinguish measured findings from unresolved safety and nutrition questions.
args.conditions: Sol has observed mature wild plums and hazelnuts. These observations established visible stock and growing conditions, not edibility. Sol has four roots and five berries as known-safe food reserves and currently has full energy and health.
args.inputs: A visible source, or a gathered sample only if physically necessary. No tools, testing equipment or reagents are assumed available.
args.costs: Specify a feasible method, time, energy, materials, learning requirements and limitations; these are currently unknown.
args.effects: Enable only findings supported by actual examination. If no informative non-ingestive examination is supported, report that limitation. Requesting or learning must not itself certify safety, reveal hidden composition or grant physical benefits.

value.summary: Assess an unfamiliar food source or sample through feasible non-ingestive examination. Distinguish measured findings from unresolved safety and nutrition questions.

candidates.function: Place one or two whole units of an owned food on the ground as a paired exposure trial, inspect their quantity and decay, end the observation or retrieve what remains.
Plant one owned root unit in a small soil plot as a persistent trial, inspect a plot by direct observation, or take back remaining planted material; resume or cancel unfinished pla
Check a site and owned branches for a freestanding branch wind screen and report what the world cannot yet support; no screen can currently be built.

execution.progress: Setup is paid work whose exact job and escrow persist across interruption; resume pays only remaining work and cancellation/death settles once. Inspect, retrieve and ending observation are atomic.

details.costs: Start: inputStackId of an owned, unspoiled, nontoxic food, quantity 1 or 2 whole units (default 2), and an unoccupied ordinary-ground x/y within 0.65 plus body radius; two work rounds at one energy each. Resume/cancel use personal processId. Inspect: target trial in reach, one round and 0.2 energy. Retrieve: operator only, one round and one energy. Cancel of an exposed trial ends observation at no cost. No supports, tools, water or fuel are used or granted.
details.effects: Completed setup places the samples at two ground positions 0.2 apart under the same ambient conditions; with one unit there is no matched control. No food moisture, drying or preservation model exists in this world: both samples keep the existing decay rules, so no treatment difference, preserved status, safety certification or extended lifetime is produced. The trial records rounds exposed and marks a 10-round observation checkpoint; ageing continues while unattended and after the checkpoint. Inspect records sample quantity and decay as a personal unverified record. Retrieve returns only the remaining material, never a replacement. Setup interruption keeps paid work; cancel releases reserved food once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort is never refunded. No reward for starting, inspecting or retrieving.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities.
